notes.title: Major Update 1.2
notes.content:
I originally had a lot of big plans for this update, and for this game in general. However, I have decided against it and will not go through with them.

I will now simply work on new projects instead.

I had a lot of things in progress for this build, but I have undone most of them, except for a few changes:
- New ambient sounds, they spawn around the room with proper spatial attenuation
- A little TV appears on the left when in game, it originally played a big part in the original planned content, but now is just a decoration
- Updated achievement pipeline to comply with new changes
- Volume of room tone greatly decreased
- Sped up some animations and movements where I could without causing issues
- A few other sound effects have also been slightly adjusted

There may have been a few other small things, but I believe that is all.

Unless if there is some game breaking bug found, there will be no further updates to this project.

Thank you all for playing and for your support.

- NanoSable

notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.content:
- Most gamemodes have had their minimum and maximum wire amounts reduced to help facilitate shorter rounds.
- All conveyors now operate at a higher speed than before
- Removed the "Conveyor Override Machine"
- The pre-existing item "Conveyor Battery" now only skips your turn
- The new item "Conveyor Hack" allows you to cut a wire, and then force Smuggy to deal with the result. This functionality was pre-existing but was tied to the Battery, causing its functionality to be misunderstood
- Due to the presence of a new item, all item spawn rates have been adjusted slightly
- Added a Room Tone to the game, providing a bit of ambient noise. More ambient noise effects are on the way

There may be minor updates if needed, but the next major update will be the LORE update, and is the last currently planned major update to the game.

As usual, feel free to drop any suggestions, and notify me of any bugs/issues.

- NanoSable

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
- Adjusted menus to make them more visible
- Adjusted pitch randomization on some sounds
- Slight adjustment to some descriptions
- Increased overlay text visibility slightly
- Fixed Wire Wizard Achievement not unlocking for some people, if you have completed Standard Mode and have not gained this achievement, it should unlock for you the next time you start up the game
- Added a base score to Endless Mode, so no matter what score you end up with, you are guaranteed to gain a 1000 points as a minimum
